summary: The KayKit barrel_small_stack matches the brief: three wooden barrels lying on their sides in a pyramid (two on the floor, one on top), brown staves with iron hoops, within budget, every assertion passing and no visible holes.

findings.observation: Hoops and lid rims mid warm grey (#827B76, Wet Slate) rather than near-black Blackened Iron; still read as metal bands.
Three 15-triangle bung parts with one open loop each on the front lids; no visible gap; none on the back lids.

questions_answered: Three barrels in a pyramid with brown staves present; hoops mid grey.
Six parts; bodies closed; bungs 1 loop each, not visible.
